Las hambrunas del “Gran Salto Adelante” y la “Revolución Cultural” marcaron al país y a su actual presidente, Xi Jipining. Ahora Pekín está impulsando la producción nacional de alimentos básicos, aumentando sus reservas y diversificando las importaciones. Brasil ya sustituyó a Estados Unidos como principal proveedor de soja, mientras China refuerza su presencia en América Latina. Además, la Iniciativa de la Franja y la Ruta funciona como una “Ruta de la Seda alimentaria”, con infraestructuras que facilitan el abastecimiento y reducen la dependencia de puntos de estrangulamiento. | DW Español

item.title: Rare hawks nest in California county after 30 years as abandoned farmland gets a new life
item.description: A California floodplain restoration project launched in 2023 has recorded its first confirmed nesting Swainson’s hawks in Shasta County in about 30 years. More than 32,000 native trees and plants were introduced across 150 acres of damaged land near the Sacramento River. Conservationists have also recorded rare indigo buntings breeding at the site, raising hopes for wildlife recovery. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: In 2023, California moved 246 endangered abalone; by 2026, counts rose from 54 to 302, with juveniles found
item.description: In 2023, researchers relocated 246 black abalone to a protected coastal site to encourage population growth. After three years, surveys recorded an increase in individuals from 54 to 302, showing signs of recovery. Juvenile abalone were also found, which raises hopes for future reproduction. This project involved collaboration among several scientific organizations and demonstrated the feasibility of habitat restoration. Ongoing monitoring will be crucial to determine the population's long-term sustainability. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Lost Eloise portrait found in dumpster sells for $100,000 after decades in closet
item.description: In a fascinating twist of fate, Eloise's original portrait, crafted by Hilary Knight in 1956, mysteriously disappeared during a Junior League Ball in 1960.
